dct_description_sm: Carbon dioxide flux measurements were conducted approximately every 3-4 days throughout the growing season using static chambers. Measurements took place within the International Tundra Experiment (ITEX) site at Cape Bounty. This is the first time that CO2 flux data has been collected in these plots continuously throughout an entire growing season. It will allow us to better understand whether experimental treatments (enhanced temperature and snow deposition) affect plot scale ecosystem respiration, productivity, and overall net ecosystem exchanges of CO2 which may be impacted by climate change.
dct_title_s: 2015 ITEX CO2 Flux, Cape Bounty, Nunavut
